identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety Study of Darolutamide (ODM-201) in Men With High-risk Non-metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multinational, Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Phase III Efficacy and Safety Study of Darolutamide (ODM-201) in Men With High-risk Non-metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: Darolutamide (BAY1841788)
armGroups.description: Participants received Darolutamide 600 mg (2 tablets of 300 mg) twice daily with food, equal to a total daily dose of 1200 mg.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received matching placebo 2 tablets twice daily with food.
